SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA

COMMUNITY PATHWAYS FOUNDATION
YOUTH WORKFORCE ADVANCEMENT INITIATIVE
RESTRICTED GRANT AGREEMENT

Grant ID: CPF-2026-0417
Grantee: Hope Community Services
Effective date: October 1, 2026
Grant period: October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027
Total restricted award: $480,000

APPROVED BUDGET
Personnel: $245,000
Employee Benefits: $55,000
Training and Curriculum: $62,000
Participant Support: $48,000
Local Travel: $20,000
Data and Evaluation: $30,000
Indirect Costs: $20,000

REPORTING CALENDAR
Quarter 1 progress and financial report due January 31, 2027.
Quarter 2 progress and financial report due April 30, 2027.
Quarter 3 progress and financial report due July 31, 2027.
Quarter 4 progress and financial report due October 31, 2027.
Final outcomes report due November 30, 2027.
Final financial report due December 15, 2027.

Each quarterly report must include a program narrative, KPI table, budget-versus-actual schedule, variance explanations, and a supporting-document checklist. The final report must also include an authorized signed certification.

PAYMENT CONDITIONS
The initial payment is made after execution. The second payment is released only after the funder accepts the Quarter 2 report. The final payment is released only after the funder accepts the final outcomes and financial reports.

COST AND BUDGET RULES
Allowable costs are reasonable personnel, participant support, curriculum, local travel, evaluation, and approved indirect costs incurred during the grant period. Alcohol, lobbying, fundraising expenses, penalties, and costs incurred outside the grant period are prohibited. Any reallocation greater than 10% of an approved budget category requires prior written approval from the Foundation.

MATCH REQUIREMENT
The grantee must document $60,000 in qualifying matching support during the grant period. Match documentation must identify the source, date, amount, and eligible purpose.

REQUIRED SUPPORT
Financial reports must include a transaction schedule, payroll-allocation support, and receipts or invoices for sampled costs. Program reports must include attendance records, participant eligibility support, and KPI source documentation.

PROGRAM KPIS
1. Enroll 180 eligible youth. Evidence: signed enrollment and eligibility records.
2. Deliver 24 workforce-readiness workshops. Evidence: attendance sheets and session logs.
3. Place 120 youth in paid work experiences. Evidence: placement records and employer confirmations.
4. Achieve 85% program completion. Evidence: completion roster and calculation worksheet.
5. Achieve 70% employment or education placement within 90 days. Evidence: follow-up survey and placement verification.

NARRATIVE QUESTIONS
Describe activities completed during the reporting period. Explain progress toward each KPI. Describe material challenges and corrective actions. Explain every budget category that differs by more than 10% from the approved period plan.

DATA, NOTICE, AND RETENTION
Participant information must be limited to the minimum needed for reporting and shared without unnecessary direct identifiers. Suspected unauthorized disclosure of participant information must be reported promptly. The grantee must notify the Foundation in writing within ten business days of a material program, budget, staffing, or schedule change. Grant records and supporting documentation must be retained for five years after acceptance of the final report.

SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS
Reports must be submitted to grants@communitypathways.example with the Grant ID in the subject line. The Grants Administration Office is the reporting contact.
